attack_techniques: Use Alternate Authentication Material: Application Access Token (T1550.001)
description: A cloud identity invoked a credential-related persistence operation.
investigative_actions: Check what API calls were executed by the identity. Check what resources are affected by this change. Look for signs that the user account is compromised (e.g. abnormal logins, unusual activity). Follow further actions done by the account.
name: Potential creation of persistent cloud credentials
